entities.summary: Lieutenant General Lê Văn Kim was a general of the Army of the Republic of Vietnam. He, his brother-in-law General Trần Văn Đôn, and General Dương Văn Minh, organised the 1963 South Vietnamese coup which toppled President Ngô Đình Diệm and ended in the assassinations of Diệm and his brother, Ngô Đình Nhu.
